works.title: Another Sky
works.description: Walk inside an O’Neill cylinder, where the landscape curves overhead. A world to explore on foot or by air, made with Astra.

works.description: How an LLM in a loop with a benchmark's own evaluator won the NeurIPS 2025 EAI Challenge — and why the recipe matters for robotics.

works.title: A Clauiet Life
works.description: What if Claude had a quiet life as a bee? A meditative pixel simulation made entirely with Claude Code.

works.title: Dyson Swarm
works.description: Interactive visualization of a Dyson swarm megastructure. Watch Mercury get dismantled to build a civilization-scale solar collector.

works.title: Power quality event classification with LSTMs
works.description: Using recurrent neural networks to classify disturbances in electrical signals. IEEE DISCOVER 2019 Best Paper Award.

milestones.title: The embodied-agent challenge
milestones.description: First place in the NeurIPS 2025 EAI Challenge at the Foundation Models Meet Embodied Agents Workshop, as team AxisTilted2.

milestones.title: Research at eBay
milestones.description: Joined eBay’s Knowledge Extraction team in April 2024. Researching and building language-model systems for information extraction. Promoted in October 2025.

milestones.title: An MS at UC San Diego
milestones.description: Completed an MS in computer science at UC San Diego. Worked with Julian McAuley’s group on AI music and language models, and TA’d recommender systems and data mining.

milestones.title: Research, made into zines
milestones.description: ZINify received an Honorable Mention at the UIST Student Innovation Contest. Experiments with language models and visual storytelling.

milestones.title: A startup that didn’t make it
milestones.description: Accepted into UCSD’s StartR Rady accelerator with Glyp, a writing assistant for novelists. The project did not make it to market; I wrote about what went wrong.

milestones.title: An industry research internship
milestones.description: Summer research with eBay’s Knowledge Extraction team, working on information extraction at scale.

milestones.title: First of 591 teams
milestones.description: Won the eBay University Machine Learning Challenge with named-entity extraction from product titles. The challenge led to the research internship.

milestones.title: From hardware to computer science
milestones.description: Started the MS at UC San Diego after three years in chip design.

milestones.title: Learning to respect silicon
milestones.description: ASIC digital design at Texas Instruments, 2019–2022: physical design, RTL, and getting actual chips out of the door.

milestones.title: Electrical engineering, and other interests
milestones.description: Graduated from NIT Karnataka in electrical and electronics engineering. Deep learning through Kaggle, a thesis on power-quality classification, and the Amateur Astronomy Club.
